proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 E F G _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ A B
  exact LinearMap.adjoint_comp A B
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 E F G : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 F] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 G] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 G] (A : F →ₗ[𝕜] G) (B : E →ₗ[𝕜] F), LinearMap.adjoint (A ∘ₗ B) = LinearMap.adjoint B ∘ₗ LinearMap.adjoint A
